purpose: Add deterministic translation-only center-to-center distance joints around the preserved AXM Physics Core, with bounded pre-core constraint projection and post-core stabilization, without pretending that angular anchors or a full rigid-joint system already exist.

properties.joints: bounded array of center-to-center distance constraints
properties.options: optional bounded positionIterations, velocityIterations, postPositionIterations and postVelocityIterations; post iteration counts may be zero to disable the second-stage stabilization explicitly

contains: post-core position and velocity stabilization receipts
distance error before and after stabilization

relationships.basis: This capability projects a target center distance and constrains relative axis velocity; the existing spring path remains intentionally soft and force-based.

limitations: no angular inertia or angular response
no hinge, slider, weld, motor or gear constraints
connected-body collision suppression is not implemented

post-core joint projection can change positions after collision/contact evidence was generated; core-stage events and contact geometry are retained and labeled as pre-post-stabilization evidence instead of being silently relabeled
persistent_state: joint definitions are explicit caller-owned JSON data

proves: bounded post-core correction of gravity-induced distance drift
explicit zero-iteration disable path for post stabilization
truthful handling of two immovable bodies

truth.basis: The capability remains explicitly translation-only, distinguishes projected joints from soft springs and unsupported angular joint families, and now labels core-stage contact evidence separately from the later stabilized final state.

agency.basis: Joint endpoints, length, correction bounds and all pre/post solver iteration counts remain caller-controlled explicit data, including the ability to set post passes to zero.

continuity.basis: The donor physics core remains byte-for-byte preserved; v0.2 changes only the additive UC joint layer and keeps the core-stage world inspectable alongside the stabilized final world.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The second wave repairs a measured single-family drift seam before attempting new angular joint families, and preserves the resulting contact-evidence limitation instead of hiding it.
